answer: Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. By the tide of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The meadow lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the quartz is where a second reviewer recomputes them. The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, slashed on a failed audit, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain.
